name: 1CP-LSD
addictionPotential: non-addictive with a low abuse potential
summary: 1cP-LSD (1-cyclopropionyl-lysergic acid diethylamide) is a novel lysergamide with little to no history of use. It is said to be a less pushy and shorter lasting version of LSD. Described as having a more gradual onset than 1P-LSD, with a less visual more meditative headspace when compared with LSD. *NOTE: This is a very new research chemical - take all info with a grain of salt.*

pharmacology.text: 1cP-LSD is a prodrug of LSD. It has been found to produce psychedelic-like effects, specifically the head-twitch response, in rodents with similar potency as 1P-LSD.

uses.text: 1cP-LSD, also known as 1-cyclopropanoyl-LSD or by the nickname Curie, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family and an acylated derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) which has been sold as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 1cP-LSD（化學名：1-環丙甲醯麥角醯二乙胺，N1--lysergic acid diethylamide）是一種有機化合物，化學式為C24H29N3O2，為麥角酸二乙醯胺的N-醯基化產物，2024年7月1日列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。
summaryZhHans: 1cP-LSD（化学名：1-环丙甲酰麦角酰二乙胺，N1--lysergic acid diethylamide）是一种有机化合物，化学式为C24H29N3O2，为麦角酸二乙酰胺的N-酰基化产物，2024年7月1日列入《非药用类麻醉药品和精神药品名录》。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is nicknamed Curie. Its cyclopropanoyl group holds a three carbon ring, one of the most strained ring shapes in chemistry.
fact.zh: 它的暱稱是「Curie」。它的環丙醯基含有一個三碳環，是化學中張力最大的環狀結構之一。
fact.zhHans: 它的暱称是「Curie」。它的环丙酰基含有一个三碳环，是化学中张力最大的环状结构之一。
